overview: A bilingual Khmer/English website for DIT RACING, a motorcycle repair and maintenance shop in Cambodia, with a photo gallery, opening hours, location and online booking.
features: Browse a photo gallery of real repair work with a full-screen lightbox
See why customers choose the shop, with opening hours and location
Open the shop location in Google Maps for directions
Book a repair online and get a reference number
Switch the whole site between Khmer and English
